en: From a playable game to a cultural business
zh: 从可玩的游戏，到持续经营的文化产品
en_script:
You've seen the game. I'll focus on the business plan: how we earn money and how we keep the project going.
We used Lovable to share ideas, Claude for design, Codex for APIs, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.

Our plan starts with customers.
Players pay for a good adventure. Schools pay for help using it in class. Museums pay for a local story their visitors can take part in.
Each needs a different product, a clear price, and a clear amount of work from us.
We need to leave enough money after that work to pay for the next story.
First, let's look at why these customers would choose us.
zh_script: 大家已经看到了游戏。我的部分聚焦商业计划：怎样赚钱，怎样让项目持续。工具方面，我们用Lovable交流想法，Claude做设计，Codex处理API，Grok完成前端与3D。商业计划从客户开始：玩家为好玩的冒险付费，学校为课堂应用支持付费，博物馆为观众可以参与的本地故事付费。每类客户需要不同的产品、明确价格和明确工作量。完成工作后，还要留下足够资金做下一个故事。首先看这些客户为什么选择我们。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 接过游戏展示，直接说明自己负责BP。
rehearsal.en:
You've seen the game. I'll focus on the business plan: how we earn money and how we keep the project going.
We used Lovable to share ideas, Claude for design, Codex for APIs, and Grok for the frontend and 3D scenes.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 看向观众，进入客户、收入和成本；无需讲右侧截图或制作细节。
rehearsal.en:
Our plan starts with customers.
Players pay for a good adventure. Schools pay for help using it in class. Museums pay for a local story their visitors can take part in.
Each needs a different product, a clear price, and a clear amount of work from us.
We need to leave enough money after that work to pay for the next story.
First, let's look at why these customers would choose us.

zh: 用户为什么选择文明航程
en_script:
Discovery Tour offers detailed historical worlds.
Minecraft Education offers flexible tools for classroom learning.
Our focus is a ready-to-play journey through Chinese and world histories.

We already have four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes built around connected stories and choices.
For players, that means a full adventure with a reason to keep playing.
For teachers, it gives them a set of stories to build a lesson around.
For museums, the same game systems give us a starting point for a local theme.
That is the position we want to build: a cultural game we can sell to players and adapt for schools and museums.

We compete by making this particular experience useful to each customer.
Our next step is to turn that position into clear products and prices.
The next slide shows exactly what each customer gets.
zh_script: Discovery Tour提供细致的历史世界，Minecraft Education提供灵活的课堂工具。我们聚焦已经可以玩的中外历史航程。四个时代、八条航线、二十四个场景，以连贯故事与选择组织起来。对玩家，是值得继续玩的完整冒险；对教师，是可以用来组织课程的一组故事；对博物馆，同一套游戏系统提供了本地主题的制作基础。我们要建立的定位是：面向玩家销售，并能适配学校和博物馆的文化游戏。竞争重点是让这个具体体验对每类客户都有用，下一步便是把定位落实为清晰的商品和价格。下一页具体讲每类客户得到什么。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左、中两栏，竞品各用一句；立即转右栏。
rehearsal.en:
Discovery Tour offers detailed historical worlds.
Minecraft Education offers flexible tools for classroom learning.
Our focus is a ready-to-play journey through Chinese and world histories.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧四时代、八航线、24场景，讲它对购买者的价值。
rehearsal.en:
We already have four eras, eight routes, and twenty-four scenes built around connected stories and choices.
For players, that means a full adventure with a reason to keep playing.
For teachers, it gives them a set of stories to build a lesson around.
For museums, the same game systems give us a starting point for a local theme.
That is the position we want to build: a cultural game we can sell to players and adapt for schools and museums.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 视线回到观众，明确竞争重点，再切产品与价格。
rehearsal.en:
We compete by making this particular experience useful to each customer.
Our next step is to turn that position into clear products and prices.
The next slide shows exactly what each customer gets.

en: What we sell, and who buys it
en_script:
For players, the plan is simple: sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
They buy it because it looks fun. They keep playing because they want to see what happens next.
If they enjoy that first voyage, we can offer new story packs at twenty-eight yuan.
So the first purchase pays for the game, and later purchases help fund new content.

A school buys help using the game in class.
The middle picture shows the teaching guide that goes with the experience.
Our plan is twelve thousand yuan a year per institution, including guides, two training sessions, and an agreed amount of support.
The school pays for something teachers can put to use. If they keep using it, the school has a reason to renew.
That gives us a way to earn annual income from the same customer.

For a museum, we build an experience around a local theme.
The price is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
We agree on the work before we start, and charge separately for additions.
Across all three offers, we reuse the research and game tools. Each customer pays for the extra work they need.
That helps us earn more from what we've built, without starting again for every sale.
Now let's look at how much money is left after we deliver.
zh_script: 玩家以68元买完整游戏，玩得好再买28元故事包。首次购买支付游戏，后续购买帮助支持新内容。学校购买课堂应用支持：机构年费1.2万元，包括指南、两次培训和约定数量的支持。教师真正用得起来，持续使用就给学校续费理由，也为我们带来同一客户的年度收入。博物馆购买本地主题互动项目，6万元包括一主题、三场景、两轮审读。开始前约定工作量，增加部分另行收费。三类业务共用研究和工具，客户为各自需要的额外工作付费，提高已有成果带来的收入，无须每次销售重新制作。接着看完成交付后还能留下多少钱。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧游戏与¥68、¥28，讲首次购买和复购。
rehearsal.en:
For players, the plan is simple: sixty-eight yuan for the full game.
They buy it because it looks fun. They keep playing because they want to see what happens next.
If they enjoy that first voyage, we can offer new story packs at twenty-eight yuan.
So the first purchase pays for the game, and later purchases help fund new content.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指中间教学指南概念图、¥12,000与交付范围。
rehearsal.en:
A school buys help using the game in class.
The middle picture shows the teaching guide that goes with the experience.
Our plan is twelve thousand yuan a year per institution, including guides, two training sessions, and an agreed amount of support.
The school pays for something teachers can put to use. If they keep using it, the school has a reason to renew.
That gives us a way to earn annual income from the same customer.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指右侧展陈概念图、¥60,000及项目范围。
rehearsal.en:
For a museum, we build an experience around a local theme.
The price is sixty thousand yuan for one theme, three scenes, and two review rounds.
We agree on the work before we start, and charge separately for additions.
Across all three offers, we reuse the research and game tools. Each customer pays for the extra work they need.
That helps us earn more from what we've built, without starting again for every sale.
Now let's look at how much money is left after we deliver.

en: Sales must fund the next story
zh: 收入要能支持下一个故事
en_script:
Let's follow the money.
Our first-year plan is based on two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
That gives us three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in sales—the blue bar on the left.

We then pay for finding customers and doing the work.
The green bar shows what's left: about a hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Building the game, creating the content, and running the business takes another two hundred and forty thousand.
So we finish the year almost eighty thousand yuan short.

That tells us what to work on.
We need cheaper ways to reach players. Teachers need materials they can use again. Museum projects need a clear limit on the work we agree to do.
A big order can look exciting. If it takes twice as long to finish, it can use up the money we need for the next story.
I want each sale to leave us enough to keep going.
That's why we'll start small and put more money in as the business proves itself.
zh_script: 顺着钱看一遍。第一年计划基于两千名付费玩家、十家机构、两个文博项目，收入37.6万元，就是左侧蓝柱。然后支付找客户和完成交付的成本，绿色剩下约16万元。游戏开发、内容制作和经营还需要24万元，因此一年下来差接近8万元。这告诉我们该改哪里：以更低成本触达玩家，让教师材料可以再用，让文博项目约定好工作量。大订单看起来令人兴奋，但如果要花两倍时间完成，就可能耗掉下个故事的钱。我希望每次销售都能留够继续做的资金，所以先小规模开始，随着业务跑通再增加投入。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指顶部客户数，再指左侧蓝柱；数字之间停半拍。
rehearsal.en:
Let's follow the money.
Our first-year plan is based on two thousand paying players, ten institutions, and two museum projects.
That gives us three hundred and seventy-six thousand yuan in sales—the blue bar on the left.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 手势顺着图往右移动。绿色约16万元，红色接近8万元，都与图上精确数字对应。
rehearsal.en:
We then pay for finding customers and doing the work.
The green bar shows what's left: about a hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Building the game, creating the content, and running the business takes another two hundred and forty thousand.
So we finish the year almost eighty thousand yuan short.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 在红柱处停一秒，然后抬头解释自己会怎么做。
rehearsal.en:
That tells us what to work on.
We need cheaper ways to reach players. Teachers need materials they can use again. Museum projects need a clear limit on the work we agree to do.
A big order can look exciting. If it takes twice as long to finish, it can use up the money we need for the next story.
I want each sale to leave us enough to keep going.
That's why we'll start small and put more money in as the business proves itself.

zh: 先投12万元，让需求带动增长
en_script:
Our total funding plan is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Most pays for the game and its stories. Some covers the wait between doing the work and getting paid. We also keep a reserve.
We'll start with one hundred and twenty thousand yuan.

First, improve the game so players finish a voyage and come back.
Then, work with paying schools and museums. Track the time, cost, and repeat use.
As customers return and payments come in, put more money into new stories.
Each project should leave something we can use again: research, teaching material, or a better game tool.
That's how this grows into a collection of cultural experiences, with less work repeated from scratch.
zh_script: 资金规划36万元，大部分用于游戏与故事，一部分用于做完工作到收到款之间的周转，同时保留储备。先投入12万元。先改善游戏，让玩家完成航程并回来；再与付费学校和博物馆合作，记录时间、成本和重复使用；随着客户回来、款项收回，再投入新故事。每个项目都留下可复用的研究、教学材料或更好的游戏工具，逐步形成丰富的文化体验，减少重复从头做的工作。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 指左侧36万元资金规划与首期12万元。
rehearsal.en:
Our total funding plan is three hundred and sixty thousand yuan.
Most pays for the game and its stories. Some covers the wait between doing the work and getting paid. We also keep a reserve.
We'll start with one hundred and twenty thousand yuan.

rehearsal.cue_zh: 沿右侧三个步骤往下讲，最后抬头看向观众。
rehearsal.en:
First, improve the game so players finish a voyage and come back.
Then, work with paying schools and museums. Track the time, cost, and repeat use.
As customers return and payments come in, put more money into new stories.
Each project should leave something we can use again: research, teaching material, or a better game tool.
That's how this grows into a collection of cultural experiences, with less work repeated from scratch.

en_script:
That's what the business plan is for: to give good stories the time and money to continue.
Civilization Voyage starts with Chinese civilization and takes us out into the world.
Along the way, we see how new tools change people's lives—and how people choose to use them.
That choice is the heart of the game.
We can build faster ships.
We still have to choose where they take us.
Let's choose a future worth arriving in.
Thank you.
zh_script: 商业计划的目的，是给好故事继续讲下去的时间和资金。文明航程从中华文明出发，带我们走向世界。一路上，我们看到新工具怎样改变生活，也看到人们怎样选择使用它。选择，就是这款游戏的核心。我们可以造出更快的船，驶向何方仍由我们选择。愿我们驶向的未来值得抵达。谢谢。

rehearsal.cue_zh: 切到神殿与航船全屏画面，停一秒。面向观众，逐渐放慢语速。
rehearsal.en:
That's what the business plan is for: to give good stories the time and money to continue.
Civilization Voyage starts with Chinese civilization and takes us out into the world.
Along the way, we see how new tools change people's lives—and how people choose to use them.
That choice is the heart of the game.
We can build faster ships.
We still have to choose where they take us.
Let's choose a future worth arriving in.
Thank you.
